fields.name: sale_id
fields.meaning: Unique identifier of one net sale/return line.

fields.name: sale_date
fields.meaning: Gregorian UTC calendar date; periods use [start, end).

fields.name: customer
fields.meaning: Customer name dimension on the sale/return line.

fields.name: region
fields.meaning: Sales region dimension on the sale/return line.

fields.name: product
fields.meaning: Product name dimension on the sale/return line.

fields.name: units
fields.meaning: Signed net units; negative values are returns; zero is valid.

fields.name: revenue_cents
fields.meaning: Signed net USD cents; returns negative; zero valid; no tax/currency conversion.
